therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with operable triple-negative breast cancer

results.target_engagement_evidence: Serum concentrations achieved: post-dose C1D1 319 µg/mL, steady-state pre-dose levels 220-258 µg/mL
biomarker_changes: 11.5% of participants developed anti-drug antibodies post-baseline
subgroup_findings: PD-L1 selected tumor status (IC1/2/3) subgroup showed no benefit
Node positive subgroup showed no benefit
safety_signals: Higher rates of leukopenia in atezolizumab arm (18 vs 5 serious events)
Febrile neutropenia similar between arms (29 vs 23 serious events)
Autoimmune hemolytic anemia (1 case in atezolizumab arm)
Quality of life scores showed greater deterioration in atezolizumab arm during treatment and follow-up
results.dose_information: Atezolizumab 840 mg IV every 2 weeks for 10 doses, then 1200 mg IV every 3 weeks to complete 1 year; combined with standard anthracycline/taxane chemotherapy

context.duration: 1 year treatment, up to 5 years follow-up
